[Experience]

Software Formal Verification Researcher | December 2024 – January 2026 | BME, Budapest

I worked on improving the efficiency and capabilities of the ⁨Theta⁩ software verification framework at ⁨FTSRG, BME⁩, under the supervision of ⁨Zsófia Ádám⁩. In collaboration with PhD researchers and other contributors, I developed methods for transferring partial results between verification algorithms and introduced a new stopping heuristic. This research won first place in the software section of the TDK conference and formed the basis of my bachelor’s thesis. I also implemented support for ⁨Software Witness 2.0⁩ using the product automaton of XCFAs and worked on optimizing IMC in Theta. I evaluated these contributions on ⁨Theta BenchCloud⁩ using ⁨SV-Benchmarks⁩ and ⁨BenchExec⁩ to obtain reproducible performance measurements.

DB Lab Instructor BME | September 2024 – January 2026 | Budapest | [View Website]

Mentored students in DBMS fundamentals, covering ER modeling, schema design, normalization, relational algebra, and advanced SQL querying (including access control and integrity), while reviewing lab assessments for accuracy.

Full-Stack Engineer | January 2025 – September 2025 | Stuttgart, Germany — remote and on site during summer

Developed and maintained a full-stack application using Vue.js and ASP.NET Core to manage worker logs, calculate wages, and generate GDPR-compliant audit reports for Königs-Villen Immobilien GmbH.

Competitive Programmer | January 2023 – September 2026 | Budapest

As a member of BME’s ⁨Vprog⁩ competitive programming group, I deepened my knowledge of algorithms and data structures through weekly ⁨Vprog Advance⁩ sessions and programming contests. I placed second in ⁨ICPC Hungary⁩ in 2023, qualifying for the Central European Regional Contest (⁨CERC⁩), followed by sixth place in 2024 and fifth place in 2025. Alongside these activities, I collaborated on software and research projects, including Qubo and San-Vitale, and co-authored a research publication.
